  > - R1: primary closure reference is now the held-out leave-one-benchmark-out predictor (fitted on training models); the in-sample fit stays as a labelled optimistic reference. k* is censored ("not reached") and kept in tables. H1 outcomes are named: k*<r_eff = dominated by a general factor (counts as H1 not supported, reported as its own outcome); in [r_eff, 2 r_eff] = knee near r_eff; above = above window.

  > - R4: MTEB and HELM MMLU are not pooled; HELM MMLU is limited to the noise-floor/theory regime. Union LLM matrix added as 'try, report overlap, drop if <~25 models cover ~12 benchmarks', with name-matching rule and audit; sparse-history study runs there.
